##### Project general facts

Hayyan by Alef Group is an inspiring natural villa community designed to reflect the idea of a life well lived, where people connect with nature in a tranquil habitat. Architecture embodies the spirit of the emirate in every design detail, creating an intimate, genuine neighbourhood shaded by native Ghaf trees. Homes rise over two or three floors, and the collection includes two-, three- and four-bedroom townhouses, premium townhouses, four-bedroom villas and luxury villas with up to six bedrooms.

Life in the community revolves around nature and the outdoors. Residents can swim in one of the largest lagoons in the emirate, stretching towards the horizon, and enjoy a community swimming pool, kids' play areas and cycling tracks that wind through green landscapes. Public attractions, landscaped parks and walking paths create places for families to gather, while the natural habitat brings encounters with gazelles and birdlife, making every day feel like a retreat.

Interiors are crafted around natural light, generous space and refined aesthetics. Living rooms feature high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the surrounding landscape, while bathrooms are designed as calm, personal spaces with carefully placed lighting and quality fixtures. Kitchens offer premium custom cabinetry, integrated appliances, under-mount sinks and designer fittings from an international brand. Bedrooms provide cosy, comfortable retreats, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Bedea is a residential area of Sharjah close to the emirate's main road network, offering a calm suburban setting with open desert landscapes and green spaces. The surrounding districts provide schools, mosques, clinics, supermarkets and community retail, while the cultural heart of Sharjah, with its museums, heritage sites and festivals, is within comfortable reach for residents and families who value culture and tradition.

Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with Dubai, Ajman and the northern emirates, while Sharjah International Airport, University City and established master communities such as Al Zahia and Tilal City are a short drive away. Dubai International Airport and central Dubai are also within comfortable driving distance for daily commuting, keeping work, shopping and leisure in both emirates within easy reach.

Sharjah offers freehold ownership to all nationalities in designated areas, and nature-led villa communities are in growing demand among families seeking space and tranquillity. Accessible entry points compared with Dubai, combined with spacious townhouses and villas and direct road connections to both emirates, support consistent demand from end users and investors focused on long-term value and rental income over time.
